scientific_integrity: A mathematical proof is provided; finite checks are corroboration and not a substitute for it. No independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The equivalence classification applies only to nonempty finite loopless tournaments in the pure directed-edge/equality language, counting-free FO^2 and unrestricted quantifier depth. It does not cover parameters, counting, infinite tournaments, arbitrary oriented graphs, or larger widths. Historical priority remains provisional against unidentified general bisimulation/composition theorems.
title: Complete counting-free two-variable theories of all finite tournaments
